domain: All public Stock issueByPolicy, scrapByPolicy and transferByPolicy calls admitted by their exact current TypeScript signatures. Each wrapper is compiler-bound to one movement-kind-specific call into the same private helper. The helper's complete 32-function same-file semantic closure and five local support declarations are checked against a frozen independent equation program; imported allocation, exact event construction, identity/measurement and durable operation semantics must already be current strict A/V, while the private ordering equation is independently rederived from the registered IdentityValues family. No runtime samples, model graph, native replay, or inferred Fungibility semantics are used.
